fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects loading of "Amsi.dll" by a living of the land process. This could be an indication of a "PowerShell without PowerShell" attack
fields.name: Amsi.DLL Loaded Via LOLBIN Process
fields.query: event.type="Module Load" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (module.path contains "\\amsi.dll" and (src.process.image.path contains "\\ExtExport.exe" or src.process.image.path contains "\\odbcconf.exe" or src.process.image.path contains "\\rundll32.exe")))
